response.sql:
SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_daily_rental_rate
FROM film
WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99
GROUP BY rating;

assumptions.assumption: AVG ignores NULL length values; rental_rate and rental_duration are non-NULL in the supplied schema, so their per-film quotient is included for every qualifying film.
